main_text.head: QUÆST. 4.

head.i: Utrum duellum licitum, quod inter rivales suscipitur?

main_text.p: Albert. Krantzi-us libr. 2.Dan. cap. 4. Olaus libr. 4. cap 5.MULTOS reperiri vanos amatores, qui amoris fortunam armis decidendam esse censeant, comprobant, & superioris, & nostri ævi exempla. Neque alia videtur occasio fabularum in Amadisiis, quam torneamenta atque duella varia, inter corrivales virginum adamatarum gratiâ suscepta. Unde quæsitum, utrum talium generum certamina, amoris æstu inita, ut licita tolerari possint, aut saltem excusari? Respondeo, etiamsi nihil sit vehementius cupidinis furore,

page.notes: Printed "MULTOS" has the initial M large and the rest in small capitals; read as MULTOS. Doubtful readings: "gratiâ" (accent as printed), "fuscepta" (the s is hard to make out in the scan). Dots and specks in the margins are scan noise, not text. The faint mark at the bottom right is not printed text.
